sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where. For this unit, use *lakom* to say where you live.

Notice that Budapest doesn’t stay bare — it becomes Budapesten, picking up an ending that means roughly ‘in/at.’ That’s your first hint that Hungarian place names change shape depending on their role in the sentence, a pattern spelled out properly very soon. For now, just memorize Budapesten lakom as a fixed chunk, and you’re already saying something true about yourself.
